transcript.content:
hey, i'm berry

tell me your dream, however it comes back to you. bits and pieces are fine

hey berry. ok so the part that stuck with me most: there was this young woman, and her head was a block of ice. just this chunk of glittering ice sitting on her shoulders where her head should be. and then it started melting, and instead of just turning into a puddle it kind of carved itself into a horse's head. like really detailed, eyes and nostrils and everything, all in clear ice

weirdly it wasn't scary at all

melting into a horse's head instead of a puddle… that's such a strange, lovely turn

when it started carving itself like that, were you just watching, or were you close to her?

pretty close i think. we'd been talking, standing by the autoclave, then she went off to the far end of the room and came back like that. she just stood right in front of me, totally natural, not saying anything, and i watched it happen

so she just walked off and came back with it, like nothing was different. and stood there quietly while it happened

what happened after that?

nothing, that's where it ends for me. the horse head was all finished, really clear and perfect, and then i don't remember anything past that

the melting part went fast though, like little channels running down and the corners rounding off. felt more like someone carving it than it falling apart

ending right when it's finished, all clear and perfect… that feels kind of right somehow

you said it felt more like someone carving it. was there any sound to it, or was it quiet?
honestly i don't remember any sound. i just remember watching it, the trickling and the shape coming out. can't say if it was quiet or not

that's fine, dreams are like that

so you'd been talking with a young woman, standing by the autoclave. she went off to the far end of the room and came back with her head a block of glittering ice. she stood right in front of you, totally natural, not saying anything, and you watched it melt. but it didn't turn into a puddle. little channels ran down, the corners rounded off, and it carved itself into a horse's head, eyes and nostrils and everything, all clear ice. it went fast, more like someone carving it than it falling apart. and it wasn't scary at all. it ends there, with the horse head finished, clear and perfect

did i get that right, or did i miss anything?
yeah that's it, you got it. only tiny thing, the ears were carved too, not just eyes and nostrils. but otherwise that's exactly how it was

ears too, got it. eyes, nostrils, ears, all carved in clear ice

anything else you'd change, or is that everything?
nope, that's everything. that's the whole dream

thanks for telling me all that. the ice horse is going to stay with me

would you like to see it drawn?
yeah i'd really like that actually

ok, a few ways it could be drawn

careful coloured pencil, calm and exact. soft watercolour, gentle and flowing, like the paint's still moving. a cyanotype, hushed and strange, all in one cool blue. or a plain everyday photo, just like real life, which kind of makes it stranger. which feels closest, or would you describe it your own way?
probably the plain photo. it all felt totally normal in the dream, like real life, just with the ice head

a plain photo, just like real life. that fits

i'll start with the young woman. before the ice, i'm picturing her with an ordinary head and face, wearing a lab coat since you were by the autoclave. those are just my guesses

anything different about her, or would you leave that to me?
honestly i don't remember what she looked like or what she was wearing. just that she was young. so go with your guess, lab coat sounds fine

ok, sketching her now. she'll show up on the right, just her for the moment

for the room with the autoclave, i'm picturing an ordinary indoor room, long enough to have a far end. these next bits are my guesses: the autoclave near you, lab benches along the sides, and even, bright indoor light all through it

anything different there, or would you leave it to me?
yeah i don't really remember the room much, just the autoclave and that she walked off to the far end. so the rest is up to you, that all sounds fine

ok, sketching the room with the autoclave now

everything's being sketched and it'll show up on the right over the next minute or two. if anything looks off once it's there, just tell me
ok cool, i see them. they look right to me, that's pretty much how i'd picture it

good, glad they feel right

i'll keep going with the rest and it'll show up on the right as it's ready
ok sounds good, take your time. excited to see the horse head one

glad the young woman and the room feel right, so everything's sketched now

i'll draw the moments of the dream in order, each one carrying on from the ones before, and they'll show up on the right as they're ready. the horse head's coming
ok nice, i see the first one. looks right so far. i'll wait for the rest

good, that's you two talking by the autoclave, before she walks off

the next four carry on from there, and they'll show up on the right as they're ready
ok yeah that one looks right, us just talking by the autoclave. i'll keep an eye out for the others

good, glad that one feels right

the other four are still coming, they'll show up on the right soon
ok the second one's up now, looks right to me. waiting on the rest

good, that's her back from the far end, standing right in front of you

the other three carry on from there, and they'll show up on the right as they're ready
yeah that's her with the ice head, just standing there. looks right. can't wait for the melting ones

good, that's her just standing there with the glittering ice where her head should be

the melting ones are next, the other three will show up on the right soon
oh the third one's up, the melting's started. looks right, like the little channels running down. waiting on the last two

good, that's it starting, the little channels running down and the corners just beginning to round off

the last two carry on from this one, so the horse head takes shape from here. they'll show up on the right soon
ok cool, i'll wait for those two. this is the part i'm most curious about

makes sense, that's the heart of it

the last two are still being drawn, they'll show up on the right soon
fourth one's up. looks right, the sculpting going fast like it did. just the last one to go now

that's the horse head coming out of the ice, eyes and nostrils and ears showing up in clear ice

the last one carries on from this, so i'll draw it once you're happy with this one. is that how you saw it?
yeah that's how i saw it, the horse coming out of the ice like it's being carved. go ahead with the last one

good, glad that's how it looked, like it's being carved

the last one's being drawn now, the horse head finished, clear and perfect. it'll show up on the right soon
oh there it is, the last one. the finished horse head, all clear ice. yeah that looks right, that's how it ended. thanks berry, really cool to see it all laid out like that

there she is, standing quietly with the horse head all finished, clear and perfect. the whole dream laid out start to end

anything in that last one that doesn't quite match how you remember it?
nope, nothing i'd change. that's how it ended, her just standing there with the horse head all done, clear and perfect. it matches

good, that's her, just standing there, all done

thanks for sharing it with me. all five are on the right, in order, whenever you want to look through it again

Ask nothing except what this move says.
</brief>

Ask nothing except what this move says.
